issue.title: Add aria-label to the booking page duration badge
issue.body: Harness test (simple change). In apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.tsx, give the duration text an accessible label like "Duration: 30 minutes" (localized, English key in packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json) without changing the visible text. Include a unit test.

pm.summary: Add a localized "Duration: 30 minutes" accessible label to the booking page duration text, with the visible text unchanged. No questions; next step is implementation with a unit test.
acceptance_criteria: For an event with a single fixed duration, the duration text has an accessible label such as "Duration: 30 minutes" (a 90-minute event reads "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes", or equivalent full-unit wording).
The same accessible label is applied when the duration selector is hidden and only the selected or default duration is shown as text.
The visible text is unchanged (for example "30m"), and the layout and styling are visually unchanged.
The label comes from a new English key in packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json, is used through t(), and has no hardcoded English string in the component.
The multiple-duration selector keeps its current behavior, and its option text and click handling are unchanged.
A unit test checks that the accessible label is present with the expected text and that the visible text is unchanged.
Existing tests for Duration.tsx and getDurationFormatted still pass, and all edits stay within the allowed scope.

research.summary: Duration.tsx renders bare text in two branches, so the label needs a wrapper. Plan next: add a new `duration_label` key, a full-unit formatter and a test in apps/web/modules.
patterns: Duration.tsx: EventDuration returns a bare fragment `<>{getDurationFormatted(...)}</>` in two places: single fixed duration (line 93) and hideDurationSelector (line 101). Neither has an element to hold aria-label, so each needs a wrapper such as `<span aria-label={...}>`. A span adds no styling, since the parent EventMetaBlock supplies it. The multi-duration selector (`<div><ul><li>`) must stay untouched.

getDurationFormatted(mins, t) produces only SHORT text, such as "30m", "1h" and "1h 30m", from keys minute_one_short, hour_one_short and multiple_duration_timeUnit_short. The label needs full units, so add a helper that reuses the existing plural keys minute_one/minute_other and hour_one/hour_other (en common.json ~1805-1810). Example: t("hour", {count}) and t("minute", {count}) joined with a space. Do not change getDurationFormatted's output, which is exported and tested.

i18n: add a key such as `"duration_label": "Duration: {{duration}}"` to packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json only. Existing `duration` is "Duration" at line 920, and other locales are filled by tooling. Check the duplicate key and the alphabetical or grouping convention near line 920 before adding.

Rendering context: Details.tsx:143-147 wraps EventDuration in EventMetaBlock (icon clock). Be aware that aria-label on a plain span has weak support without a role. Consider a visually-unchanged wrapper with the visible text inside, and consider `role="text"` or an sr-only alternative only if the PM's criteria allow it. The criteria call for an aria-label, so use aria-label and assert it with getByLabelText.

Test: new file apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.test.tsx. The vitest.workspace.ts project covering `apps/web/modules/**/*.{test,spec}.tsx` (line 188) uses jsdom and setupFiles apps/web/modules/test-setup.ts. Follow DatePicker.test.tsx, which uses `render` from @calcom/features/bookings/Booker/__tests__/test-utils and vi.mock. Mock useLocale to return a t that resolves the English keys, or use the real i18n setup if test-setup provides it. Mock useBookerStoreContext, useIsPlatform, useIsEmbed and useShouldShowArrows (from @calcom/web/modules/apps/components/AllApps) as needed. Cases: fixed 30 min gives label "Duration: 30 minutes" and visible "30m"; 90 min gives "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes"; hideDurationSelector with multipleDuration and selectedDuration; multiple-duration selector has no label and its options still render and click.

Commit style: merge-commit PRs from branches, with conventional-style prefixes like `ci/...`. Check `git log --oneline -20` at plan time. Scope: all edits fall under apps/web/ and packages/i18n/locales/. No human-review prefixes are touched.

design_need.summary: No design needed: this adds an accessible label to existing duration text, with no new screen and no visible change. Next step is the plan and implementation with a unit test.

plan.summary: Wrap the two text-only branches of EventDuration in a span with a localized full-unit aria-label from a new English key, leaving visible text unchanged. Next: implement and add a unit test.

tests.purpose: Checks aria-label "Duration: 30 minutes" with visible "30m" for a fixed event, "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes" for 90 minutes, and the label in the hideDurationSelector branch. Also checks that the multi-duration selector has no label and its options still render and call setSelectedDuration on click.
Also covers getDurationFormatted staying unchanged ("30m", "1h", "1h 30m"). No existing Duration tests were found, so these cases are added to the new file.

acceptance_criteria: A fixed-duration event renders its text inside an element with aria-label "Duration: 30 minutes", and a 90-minute event gets "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes".
The hideDurationSelector branch uses the same label, built from selectedDuration or event.length.
Visible text is unchanged ("30m", "1h 30m") and no styling or layout changes.

The label comes from a new key `duration_label` ("Duration: {{duration}}") in en/common.json, used via t(), with no hardcoded English in the component. Full units reuse the existing minute and hour plural keys.
The multi-duration selector markup and behavior are untouched.
getDurationFormatted output and its export are unchanged.
The new unit test passes, and type-check and lint pass.
All edits stay within the allowed scope, and no human-review paths are touched.
steps: Check that `duration_label` does not already exist in en/common.json. Add `"duration_label": "Duration: {{duration}}"` right after `"duration"` (line 920). Edit English only.

In Duration.tsx, add an exported helper `getDurationLabelFormatted(mins, t)`. It computes hours and remainder minutes and builds the text with t("hour", {count}) and t("minute", {count}), joined by a space. It returns null when mins is falsy. Leave getDurationFormatted untouched.

Add a small internal `DurationText` helper, or inline the logic, that renders `{short}`. Use it in the fixed-duration branch (line 93) and the hideDurationSelector branch (line 101), and skip the wrapper when mins is falsy.

Create Duration.test.tsx following DatePicker.test.tsx. Mock useLocale with a t that resolves the English strings (with plural handling), plus useBookerStoreContext, useIsPlatform, useIsEmbed and useShouldShowArrows. Cover the cases listed under tests.
Run `TZ=UTC yarn vitest run apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.test.tsx`, then the bookings components folder, then the web type-check and lint.

evaluation.summary: Plan matches the issue and all PM criteria, stays in scope, and every criterion has a test. Aligned and low risk; proceed to implementation with minor notes.
findings: Scope: the three files are under apps/web/ and packages/i18n/locales/ with allowed extensions. No human-review or protected paths are touched.
Criteria 1 and 2 (fixed and hideDurationSelector labels) are covered by the 30-minute, 90-minute and hideDurationSelector test cases.
Criterion 3 (visible text unchanged) is covered by asserting the visible text "30m" and "1h 30m" inside the labelled span.

Criterion 4 (new English key used via t()) is covered by the duration_label step. The test only sees the key through its mocked t, so no test checks the real en/common.json value. Consider loading the real English JSON in the mock so a typo in the key or its text fails the test.
Criterion 5 (selector unchanged) is covered by asserting that the multi-duration selector has no label and its options still render and call setSelectedDuration on click.
Criterion 6 (unit test for label and visible text) is covered by the new Duration.test.tsx.

Criterion 7 is covered by the getDurationFormatted cases and the type-check and lint steps. The plan lists the getDurationFormatted cases as an existing_test, but they go in the new file; this is a labelling nit, not a gap.
Risk: aria-label on a bare span has weak screen-reader support without a role. The plan follows the issue's request for an aria-label, so this is acceptable. Mention the limitation in the PR notes.
The falsy-mins edge case is handled by skipping the wrapper. A zero-duration test case would make this explicit.

implementation.summary: The booking page duration text now has a localized label like "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes", and the visible text is unchanged. New tests and lint pass. Workspace type-check fails, but none of its errors are in changed files. Ready for validation.
verification: TZ=UTC yarn vitest run apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.test.tsx: 1 file, 6 tests passed. The tests use real i18next with en/common.json and cover: fixed 30m gets the label "Duration: 30 minutes"; 90m gets "Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes" with visible "1h 30m"; the hidden-selector branch gets "Duration: 1 hour"; the multi-duration selector has no label and clicking an option still calls setSelectedDuration(60); getDurationFormatted still returns "30m", "1h" and "1h 30m".
TZ=UTC yarn vitest run apps/web/modules/bookings/components: 4 files, 21 tests passed.

yarn workspace @calcom/web type-check: fails with 597 errors in 156 files across the repo. None are in Duration.tsx or Duration.test.tsx. I did not compare against main, so I have not confirmed that all 597 were already there before this change.
yarn workspace @calcom/web lint: 996 files checked, 0 errors (warnings and infos only).

yarn biome check on the test file: no errors or warnings, 2 infos. On Duration.tsx: 1 error, the import order, which was already there before this change; I left the imports alone to keep the diff small. The new helpers get only the same warnings the rest of the file has (noTernary, useExplicitType). common.json: clean.

Implementation: added a `duration_label` key ("Duration: {{duration}}") to the English common.json only, after `duration`. Added an exported `getDurationLabelFormatted` that builds full units from the existing hour/minute plural keys, and an internal `DurationText` span with the aria-label, used in the fixed-duration and hide-selector branches. getDurationFormatted and the multi-duration selector are unchanged.
